name: volc-agent-launchpad
description: A middleware-free Agent platform starter kit running Codex CLI locally or on Volcengine ECS.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @launchpad/server" "npm run dev -w @launchpad/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchpad/web && npm run build -w @launchpad/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && npm run typecheck:tests -w @launchpad/server && npm run typecheck:tests -w @launchpad/web
scripts.test: node --test scripts/start-local-poc-launcher.test.mjs && npm run test -w @launchpad/server && npm run test -w @launchpad/web
scripts.test:e2e:starter-kit: npm run test:e2e:harness:unit && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.tmp/playwright-browsers playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/starter-kit.spec.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:shepherd-hero: npm run test:e2e:harness:unit && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.tmp/playwright-browsers playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts tests/e2e/shepherd-hero.spec.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
